name: Miyuki Mashiro
source:
"I can no longer live in a world without you."

The shrine maiden of Shiraki Hiyori. She is commonly known as the "Shiro no Miko."

With her domestic, friendly personality, and lovely appearance, she is popular in school. She doesn't like to fight, but on the other hand, she has a side for herself that hates to lose and is a hard worker.

She dislikes ghosts and scary stories. Her dream is to become a "Kuro no o Yomesan".

[Translated from [url=http://mikatuki.sakura.ne.jp/m/contents/character/img/chara_shiro.png]official website[/url]]
